{{Top|canon=Micronite charge}}
'''Micronite''' was the name given to a tiny timed [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charge]] developed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]. Micronite was created by using a [[gram]] of [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] wrapped inside a piece of flexible, wadable material like [[SlipSheet]] or a [[Godon Frezzes]] wrapper. This was then wrapped around the target to destroy, usually a wire, then connected to a timer, hence the term "micronite."
